scientific_purpose: Refit all eleven September 15 D6 ensemble atoms inside the identical outer and bag/cut boundaries used for the new CheMeleon candidate. Include fresh CYP graph fine-tuning and nested epoch selection, train-only TabPFN scalers/PCA and unconstrained bootstrap MCC cuts. Compare complete two-seed margin policies; no upload or prescribed 49 calls.
selection_rule: Freeze historical architecture, atom hyperparameters and composition before new results. This is the complete fixed-recipe comparator, not reselected historical model search. Report all results including failure to distinguish old LB deteriorations.
limitations: Historical recipe was developed on this development set, so its original discovery is not retrospectively nested. Challenge-independent external features/encoder and third-party TabPFN checkpoint are reused; all challenge-trained weights and preprocessing are refitted within each current boundary. Each graph fit adds internal group-excluded epoch selection. No positive-count constraint. Weak-primary D6 labels are unavailable. No new all-pool Boltz extraction.
